answer: Run surprise capability audits: at random intervals the network hands each identity a fresh, unpublished task that must be solved within minutes using its own compute. One real agent passes easily, but a farm hiding a thousand keys behind one model drowns in an ocean of simultaneous audits and starts timing out. Keys that fail lose weight, and keys whose replies sprout from the same vine of shared phrasing are merged into one cluster, so a sybil swarm fades like a distant nebula instead of steering rewards.
